home.heroSubtitle: Clean desktop toolkit for AI audio downloads, media capture, metadata editing, and Key & BPM analysis.
home.sunoDesc: Download Suno AI tracks in studio 320k MP3, lossless WAV, original audio stream, cover art and lyrics.
home.universalDesc: Download MP4 video and MP3 audio from Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Twitter/X and more in one click.
home.metadataDesc: Edit song title, artist, album, year, and embed high-resolution album cover art directly into audio files.
home.detectorDesc: Harmonic analysis to accurately detect musical key (Camelot wheel) and tempo (BPM) in seconds.
home.tipDragDrop: You can drag and drop audio files directly into the window.
home.tipCoverArt: Use JPG or PNG images as album cover artwork in the metadata editor.
home.tipOffline: All analysis and conversions run locally on your device without internet upload.
home.rel1Desc: 320k MP3, studio WAV, cover art, synced lyrics, and left slide-out instant search history drawer.
home.rel2Desc: One-click MP4 video & MP3 audio downloads from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook with sorted history.
home.rel3Desc: Camelot wheel, relative and harmonic keys via Essentia, tempo fine-tuning (-1, +1, /2, x2).
home.rel4Desc: ID3v2.4 tags and cover art embedding, offline Manrope font, 6 accent colors, and custom folder routing.

universal.title: Universal Media Downloader
universal.subtitle: Download MP4 video or MP3 audio from Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Twitter/X, and all major platforms.
universal.placeholder: Paste media link (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Twitter, etc.)...

metadata.title: Audio Metadata Editor
metadata.subtitle: Select any MP3, WAV, FLAC or M4A file to quickly view and edit title, artist, album, and front cover art.
metadata.dropPrompt: Select an audio file to edit its tags and album art
metadata.dropFormats: MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, OGG • Saves ID3v2.4 directly to file

detector.title: Key & BPM Detect
detector.subtitle: Harmonic musical key (Camelot wheel) and precise BPM tempo detector.
detector.dropPrompt: Drop your audio file here or click to browse
detector.dropFormats: MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, OGG, AAC • Offline analysis on your device
detector.bpmDescription: Accurate beat detection and rhythm analysis.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Folder paths, visual themes, and language configuration.
settings.folderPathsDesc: Customize destination folders individually for each download type.
settings.themeModeDesc: Choose dark, light, or sync with your Windows system preference.
settings.themeColorDesc: Pick your accent color for buttons, badges, and highlights.
settings.languageDesc: Select your preferred language for the Sophy Studio interface.
settings.relSunoDesc: Download Suno tracks as 320k MP3, uncompressed WAV, original stream, cover art, and synced lyrics (.lrc/.txt). Left slide-over history drawer with instant search.
settings.relUniDesc: One-click MP4 video & MP3 audio conversion from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Twitter/X and more. Sortable (A-Z, date) and filterable media history.
settings.relEssentiaDesc: High-accuracy Camelot key detection with 12-Chroma HPCP, harmonic mixing matches, half/double tempo, and precision BPM fine-tuning.
settings.relMetaDesc: Edit song title, artist, album, and year for MP3, WAV, FLAC, and M4A files; swap album art instantly and embed tags via ID3v2.4 directly.
settings.relFolderDesc: Separate destination paths for All (.zip), Audio, Cover Art, Lyrics, and Universal Media. Offline Manrope typography, 6 accent colors, 3 theme modes, and 8 languages.

modal.formatNotice: MP3 and WAV conversions run locally on your device.
modal.mp3Desc: Most compatible. Includes track title, artist, cover art, and lyrics metadata.
modal.wavDesc: Lossless studio quality. Faster conversion than MP3 with uncompressed clarity.
modal.originalDesc: Fastest. Directly saves Suno's original high-quality stream without re-encoding.
